evals.prompt: Validate the Agentic Workflow Architecture plan registration.

assertions.text: The output identifies the plan path and status.
assertions.evidence: validate-plan-sync.mjs reports plan.path and plan.status in JSON output.

assertions.text: The output separates errors from warnings.
assertions.evidence: All validation reports include counts.errors and counts.warnings.

evals.prompt: Inventory current agents and skills after the numbered SDLC orchestrator migration.

assertions.text: The inventory includes total and user-invocable agent counts.
assertions.evidence: inventory-customizations.mjs reports agents and userInvocableAgents in summary output.

assertions.text: The inventory includes total and user-invocable skill counts.
assertions.evidence: inventory-customizations.mjs reports skills and userInvocableSkills in summary output.
